properties.title: Blackfriars Underground station reopened after redevelopment
properties.short_description: London City Hall recorded the larger and more accessible Blackfriars Underground station reopening for public service on 20 February 2012 after a three-year rebuild.
properties.explanation: A rebuilt Tube station with new lifts, escalators, entrance hall, and better Tube-rail connections returned to public use.

properties.title: Brunel University Eastern Gateway Building completed
properties.short_description: Brunel University's institutional timeline records the Eastern Gateway Building as completed in 2012 at its Uxbridge campus.
properties.explanation: A university campus building reached documented completion at Brunel's Uxbridge campus.

properties.title: Clapham Library opened on Clapham High Street
properties.short_description: Lambeth Council's news blog recorded in July 2012 that the new Clapham Library had opened its doors as part of the Clapham One regeneration scheme.
properties.explanation: A new public library building entered use within a mixed-use scheme combining library, health, cafe, community rooms, public facilities, and housing.

properties.title: The Crystal opened to the public at Royal Victoria Dock
properties.short_description: Siemens announced that The Crystal urban sustainability centre at Royal Victoria Dock would open to the public during the week commencing 24 September 2012.
properties.explanation: A purpose-built exhibition and events building entered public use in the Royal Docks.

properties.title: Cutty Sark reopened after conservation
properties.short_description: GOV.UK recorded the official reopening of Cutty Sark on 25 April 2012 after an extensive conservation project.
properties.explanation: A conserved maritime heritage attraction reopened to visitors in Greenwich.

properties.title: Dalston C.L.R James Library officially opened
properties.short_description: Hackney Council News recorded the official opening celebration for the new Dalston C.L.R James Library on 28 February 2012.
properties.explanation: A new three-floor public library entered documented use at Dalston Square, replacing an older library with a larger community facility.

properties.title: Deptford Lounge opened as a community hub
properties.short_description: Deptford Lounge records the Pollard Thomas Edwards-designed building opening in 2012.
properties.explanation: A combined library, school, community learning, council-service, studio, and housing facility entered public use in Deptford.

properties.title: Forest Hill Pools reopened after replacement works
properties.short_description: Lewisham Council's 2012-2013 statement of accounts recorded Forest Hill Pools reopening in September 2012.
properties.explanation: A rebuilt local swimming and leisure facility returned to documented public use in Forest Hill.

properties.title: Forty Hall reopened after major restoration
properties.short_description: Forty Hall Estate announced that Forty Hall would reopen to the public over the weekend of 30 June and 1 July 2012 after a major restoration project.
properties.explanation: A restored historic house and museum re-entered public use with refurbished interiors, access works, courtyard works, and interpretation.

properties.title: Great Ormond Street Hospital Morgan Stanley Clinical Building officially opened
properties.short_description: Great Ormond Street Hospital recorded that the Morgan Stanley Clinical Building was officially opened on 14 June 2012.
properties.explanation: A new clinical building entered official use at Great Ormond Street Hospital as part of the Mittal Children's Medical Centre programme.

properties.title: Granary Square officially opened at King's Cross
properties.short_description: Granary Square officially opened as a new canalside public square in the King's Cross Central redevelopment.
properties.explanation: A large new public-realm space became accessible at the centre of the King's Cross redevelopment area.

properties.title: Jubilee Gardens reopened as a re-landscaped South Bank park
properties.short_description: Jubilee Gardens Trust records the 2012 re-landscaping by West 8, the transfer of management responsibility to the community-based trust in May 2012, and the later royal inauguration of the new gardens.
properties.explanation: A re-landscaped public park with new planting, paths, seating, and play space entered documented public use beside the London Eye.

properties.title: Kensington Palace reopened after public-facing refurbishment
properties.short_description: Base Structures records Kensington Palace reopening in 2012 after a 12 million GBP renovation associated with Historic Royal Palaces Trust and John Simpson and Partners.
properties.explanation: A palace visitor site reopened with refreshed public access and exhibition/entrance works around the named Kensington Palace location.

properties.title: King's Cross western concourse opened
properties.short_description: Network Rail recorded the public opening of the new western concourse at King's Cross station on 19 March 2012.
properties.explanation: A major rail-station concourse and passenger route entered public use at King's Cross.

properties.title: Barking and Dagenham HMO Article 4 direction area took effect
properties.short_description: Planning Data records a Barking and Dagenham boroughwide HMO Article 4 direction area with start date 2012-05-14.
properties.explanation: Article 4 planning-control status for houses in multiple occupation in Barking and Dagenham.

properties.title: Leicester Square reopened after public-realm transformation
properties.short_description: The Greater London Authority recorded Leicester Square officially reopening on 23 May 2012 after a 17-month public-realm transformation managed by Westminster City Council.
properties.explanation: Leicester Square's public realm reopened with new paving, planting, lighting, seating, and works around the central Shakespeare statue.
